role: Clones a written book: one written book plus N writable books gives N+1 written book copies carrying the original's tag and display name.

members.name: matches
members.note: one written book (damage 0 or the tag marks it written) and at least one writable one, nothing else

members.name: getCraftingResult
members.note: n/a: matches() needs a written book, which only signing a book and quill makes (book_editing = off); no loot, drop or trade holds one

members.name: getRecipeSize
members.note: the size-9 constant only mattered to the sort, already baked

members.name: getRecipeOutput
members.note: returns null in Java until a match sets the field; the native answers none

notes: book_editing = off only stops editing a book and quill; cloning a written book is deterministic and stays in scope.
